paths.name: .NET · 4 YOE Path
paths.desc: Built from the deep-research reports and 4 YOE handbook: trade-offs, ASP.NET, EF/SQL, security, messaging, memory diagnostics, CQRS, SCIM, and system-design drills interviewers actually ask around 4 years experience.

paths.name: SQL
paths.desc: The gap that costs most people offers. Every topic covered at interview depth — syntax, gotchas, edge cases, and the "why" behind each concept.

paths.name: .NET / C#
paths.desc: OOP depth, async mastery, C# 14 new features, ASP.NET Core, EF Core — tied to your SCIM and compliance platform work.

paths.name: Angular
paths.desc: From component fundamentals to signals, zoneless change detection, and the complete Angular 22 API — production v17 experience + everything that shipped since.

paths.name: Senior Depth
paths.desc: System design, production ownership, leadership signals, scaling — what separates 4-YOE candidates from 2-YOE in final rounds.

paths.name: Python
paths.desc: Python through a C# lens. Syntax, pandas, file I/O, SQL integration, generators, decorators, testing.

paths.name: PySpark + Scala
paths.desc: Spark processes data that doesn't fit on one machine. Every PySpark concept maps to something you already know from Python and SQL.

paths.name: AWS + Cloud
paths.sub: S3, EMR, CloudWatch, Grafana, orchestration - 14 days
paths.desc: The cloud infrastructure and observability layer for your data pipeline. Goes deep on CloudWatch and Grafana -- the exact AWS-native monitoring stack the JD's near-real-time dashboard implies -- plus serverless orchestration, Glue/Athena, and cost control.

paths.name: Terraform + Observability
paths.sub: IaC, Grafana, Kibana, NiFi, ML - 6 days
paths.desc: Infrastructure-as-code and observability tools complete the production data engineering stack. Terraform makes infrastructure repeatable. Grafana/Kibana make pipelines visible. NiFi automates data movement.

paths.name: S&P Domain + Lead I
paths.desc: S&P Global domain knowledge plus Lead I behavioral questions. Final round interviews test judgment and ownership, not just code.

paths.name: Azure
paths.desc: A parallel-track crash course mapping everything you already know from AWS onto Azure -- same concepts (object storage, IAM, managed Spark), new vocabulary and a few genuine structural differences.

paths.name: GCP
paths.desc: Google Cloud's take on the same pipeline stack -- Cloud Storage, Dataproc (managed Spark), Cloud Monitoring, and Grafana on GCP. Google's IAM model and BigQuery are the two areas with the most genuine conceptual difference from AWS.
